r.정치 구도: A federation with a strong presidency and a great many parties, so the president must build alliances with several parties in Congress to pass laws. The left-wing Workers' Party and the right are sharply opposed, and after the 2022 election supporters who rejected the result stormed Congress and the Supreme Court. The Supreme Court plays a big political role, so trials of former presidents and social media regulation are frequent news. President Lula won again in the October 2026 runoff.

t.why: South America's largest economy and a founding member of BRICS. About 60% of the Amazon rainforest is in Brazil, so the pace of deforestation is global climate news, and in 2025 it hosted the UN climate conference, COP30, in the Amazon city of Belem. As one of the world's top exporters of soybeans, coffee, sugar, beef and iron ore, its harvests and output move world food and commodity prices. It leads Mercosur, the South American common market, and tries to side with neither the United States nor China.
t.rel: A regional power that borders most South American countries. A founding member of BRICS, it tries not to lean toward either the United States or China, and its protection of the Amazon draws international attention.
t.korea: The two established relations in 1959. Korea buys raw materials such as iron ore, soybeans and chicken and sells car parts and electronics. Hyundai and Samsung have local plants. The Korean community in Sao Paulo, which began with farm immigration in the 1960s, is the largest in South America.
t.know: Brazil has the largest population of Japanese descent outside Japan.
etext: With its vast land and climate, it is one of the world's top sellers of soybeans, beef, chicken, sugar, coffee and orange juice. Its farming technology adapted to tropical soils is excellent.
Its iron ore output is among the world's highest, and crude production from deep-sea fields has risen sharply. It makes most of its electricity from hydropower and widely uses sugarcane ethanol fuel.
Its maker of midsize passenger jets is world-class. A large population makes for a big domestic market, and fintech has spread fast.
A complex tax system and high interest rates make business investment hard. Transport infrastructure such as roads and railways is lacking.
